summary: King Long Technology (Suzhou) Limited specializes in semiconductor back-end services, offering a wide range of testing solutions including wafer probe, final test, pre-assembly, burn-in, and drop shipment services. They serve as a 'One Stop Shop' for IC testing, supporting foundries, IDMs, and fabless companies with innovative testing methodologies.
